insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident; designed for parents with only girl children; dependent daughter cover up to 25 yrs (unlimited for mentally challenged or unmarried dependent daughter)
specific_diseases_listed: Cataract and age related eye ailments (24 months)
Prolapse inter vertebral disc and spinal diseases (24 months)
Stone in Gall bladder / Bile duct (24 months)
Puberty and Menopause related Disorders (24 months)
Joint Replacement due to Degenerative Condition (48 months)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 48 months; specific waiting 90 days/24 months/48 months by condition class

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent up to 1% of SI/day; ICU up to 2% of SI/day; proportionate deduction on associate medical expenses if higher room category opted

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care procedures plus 12 Modern Treatments with per-procedure caps (e.g. robotic surgery 50% SI max Rs 2L, stem cell therapy 50% SI max Rs 1.5L)

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for AYUSH inpatient treatment

maternity_coverage.notes: Maternity expenses excluded under Excl18 (only ectopic pregnancy treatment covered)

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excluding cost of organ) for covered organ transplant

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Critical Care Benefit: flat 10% of Sum Insured paid in addition to claim for 11 listed critical illnesses (cancer, heart attack, CABG, organ transplant, etc.)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Once-in-lifetime per insured; not payable if condition is pre-existing

copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-pay when treatment is outside the Area of Coverage (zone) declared in schedule; otherwise none

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: 10% of SI or Rs 50,000 per eye, whichever less
disease_wise_sub_limits.mental_illness: 25% of SI per policy period after 48-month waiting
disease_wise_sub_limits.armd: 10% of SI, max Rs 75,000 after 48 months
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospital_cash: 0.1% of SI per day; max 1% of SI per any-one-illness
disease_wise_sub_limits.personal_accident: 100% of SI per spouse, 200% of SI both

permanent_exclusions: RFQMR, ECP, EECP, hyperbaric oxygen therapy
notable_exclusions_summary: Niche product for parents of only-girl children; maternity expenses NOT covered. Standard IRDAI exclusion list applies including infertility, cosmetic, hazardous sports, war and nuclear, dental (unless accident), naturopathy.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA: pre-authorisation within 1 hour, final discharge authorisation within 3 hours. Helpline 1800-209-1415. Reimbursement via claim form download from insurer website.
